Safe Project Initialization: forgeops init [PATH] (safe, deterministic bootstrap of the minimum ForgeOps governance structure - CLAUDE.md, .agent/CURRENT_STATE.json, .agent/PROJECT_FACTS.md, .agent/DECISIONS.md, .agent/HANDOFF.md) - forgeops/state/project_init.py (preflight plan builder, content renderers, rollback-on-failure writer), forgeops/cli/init.py; forgeops/core/paths.py gained READONLY_REFERENCE_REPO/is_protected_reference_path (a second, independent TrendForge-protection layer alongside the existing PreToolUse hook); ownership/conflict model (missing/compatible/conflict per managed path, an ownership marker for markdown files, reused schema-version compatibility for CURRENT_STATE.json but intentionally more conservative than forgeops checkpoint's leniency), atomic all-or-nothing writes with rollback on failure, dry-run returning the same exit code a real run would, non-Git support, no speculative .agent/runtime|checkpoints|logs directories pre-created - see docs/project-init.md; 579 passing tests (up from 528); real disposable-directory validation (dry-run, real init, idempotent second run, JSON dry-run, CLAUDE.md conflict) executed this session; on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing, uncommitted pending review (per this checkpoint's explicit stop-boundary instruction not to commit this work)
